verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Git Sync keeps project data in the user's own Git repository rather than hosted by Insomnia, and projects can be converted to Local Vault storage. Both support leaving with your data. The docs also have an import/export page listing open formats (OpenAPI, HAR, Postman, cURL), though the quoted text never explicitly confirms export of all data in those formats. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full-account/all-data export, confirmation of which open formats are export targets (vs. import-only), independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Git Sync connects Insomnia directly to your Git repository. Your project data stays in your repository. Insomnia does not host or manage it.
You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync
Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL
